title: Fuse it: niche strategies into our own
question: Six scouts verified about 40 niche ideas from far-off fields and a synthesis fused them into six synergies. Which are real, which are decoration, and what does each change?
serves: Ahaan's ask (I53-I54); north stars 3-4; Investment Strategy, Portfolio Analysis, Client Knowledge, Creativity
essence: Six fields gave one discipline: sort every dollar by what can fail it, and decide in advance who pays when it does.
The Lab killed our own favourite fix (a 2028 hold-back, $9k of gift) and kept a cheaper one: re-measure the coupon gap in January 2031, before the range is named, for about $160.
decided: 6-0: re-measure the coupon gap in January 2031 before the range is named, and keep the 2033 cushion (both or neither)
6-0: name the one shared cause (a slump that shrinks her income and makes bonds dearer); drop the 2028 hold-back
6-0: Laura's kept half is a standby, called last, not 'the project's second cheque'
6-0: two standards of proof: the floor needs no history, only the top does; never quote US-history odds
seeds: The 2031 lock vs 'three times worse' (k 3.1 vs 5-10): Courtroom, Wed 28 Oct
